objective: Establish HolyAgent version and installation facts, the correct dependency-update base branch, and whether state migration is required before updating dependencies.
scope: Read-only investigation of the user-level Pi installation, this repository, open PRs and released versions using gh and package metadata.
Inspect dependency updater documentation and migration status without modifying files or state.
constraints: Use kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding for the delegated Pi run.
Use gh for GitHub release and PR facts. Distinguish published stable npm versions, GitHub releases and unreleased PR heads.
Identify the exact user-level installed source/version/location and the repository main version/location.
Apply AGENTS.md release-branch and dependency-updater rules. Recommend a concrete work-branch start from the actual open owner PR stack and its PR base; do not infer from branch names alone.
Determine whether holyagent migrate --dry-run reports legacy state requiring migration; do not run a real migration.
Do not edit files, switch branches, install updates or write version-control state.
Report in under 400 words with exact versions, refs, paths and commands.

criteria.text: Versions: identify installed HolyAgent source/version/location, repository version, latest published stable version and any later unreleased PR version, with gh or package evidence.
Update plan: identify the documented updater and caret-format checks plus the correct branch start and PR base under the active repository conventions and open stack.
Migration: establish whether migration is needed using read-only evidence and name the safe command if it is.
Scope: make no changes to either checkout, user installation or state.
